'''Droma Ordo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Yeah, seems to be a lot of people looking to help out once we won the battle of Yavin 4. Where were you before? Never mind. I do have some low security jobs I can farm out.|Droma Ordo, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RBH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Rebel Bantha Hunt|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Droma Ordo was stationed in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], along with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra]], and both recruited new members to join the Rebellion's cause.<ref name="SWG:StS" /> He was also in contact with [[Jorund Redd]], a Rebel sympathizer living in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:CitC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Medic|Caught in the Crossfire|Tatooine}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Ordo recruited a spacer to perform several missions to aid the Alliance.<ref name="SWG:StS" /> One such mission was to thin out the [[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]] population around Anchorhead to decrease the number of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrols as [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtroopers]] had begun using Banthas in addition to the reptilian [[Dewback/Legends|Dewbacks]].<ref name="SWG:RBH" /> Another was to retrieve stolen codes from a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group that operated near Anchorhead.<ref name="SWG:TC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Terrorist Codes|Tatooine}}</ref> The third was retrieve a [[RX-8 modulator]] from an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] leg stored at a high-security [[Valarian Depot|compound]] run by the [[Valarian Syndicate]] to test a new jamming program.<ref name="SWG:MR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Modulator Retrieval|Tatooine}}</ref> The trooper was spotted by a squad of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who attempted to give Imperial troops information about the mission. The trooper followed the mercenaries to an Imperial outpost near [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] where the trooper eliminated the squad and returned to Ordo. Ordo gave the trooper [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]] as a reward then informed the trooper that, due to an Imperial investigation, he would no longer be giving missions.<ref name="SWG:CyT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Cover your Tracks|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Droma Ordo appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:StS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Droma Ordo was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
